# nekomimi-mcp — Full Documentation

## Overview
nekomimi-mcp is a substrate-independent embodiment layer for conversational NPCs. It provides an abstract expressive vocabulary (intent tokens) that is rendered on whatever physical or virtual body is available.

Architecture: INTENT layer (LLM emits tokens) -> RENDER layer (per-body translators).

## MCP Tools (verb-led primaries; historic *_tool names are deprecated aliases)

### express_intent
Express a single intent token. Parameters:
- token: One of: attending, confused, nod, shake, sulk, bashful, amused, surprised, curious, alarmed, excited, tired, attentive_listen, celebrate, apologetic, present, idle
- renderer: Target body (boomy, vrm, reachy_mini, bhl) or None for all
- timing_seconds: Duration (0.1-10.0)
- speed: Speed multiplier (0.0-1.0)
- intensity: Amplitude (0.0-1.0)
- easing: linear, ease_in, ease_out, ease_in_out, snap, bounce
- hold_seconds: Sustain end pose
- hesitation: Initial delay
- repeat: Repetitions (1-10)

### play_intent_stream
Execute a sequence of intents in order. Parameters: tokens (list), renderer (optional), loop (boolean).

### list_intents
List all registered intent tokens with defaults.

### list_renderers
List available body renderers with status.

### describe_renderer
Detailed info about one renderer.

### preview_boomy_mapping
Preview how an intent maps to Boomy's specific actuators.

### get_safety_status
Read safety subsystem state.

### retreat_safely
Execute guarded reverse motion with timeout.

### list_recordings
List recorded intent streams.

### replay_recording
Replay a recorded stream (regression testing).

### export_recordings
Export to JSONL.

### get_status
Server status: uptime, tool/alias counts, renderer summary.

### shutdown_server
Graceful shutdown (requires confirm=True).

### show_renderers_card
Renderer list as a Prefab in-chat card.

## Prompts and resources

Prompts: nekomimi_intent_guide, nekomimi_character, renderer_comparison.
Resources: skill://nekomimi-operator.

## Renderers

| Name | Body Type | Hardware | Status |
|------|-----------|----------|--------|
| boomy | Yahboom Raspbot V2 (differential + PTZ) | Real | Ready |
| vrm | VRM 1.0 canonical humanoid | Preview | 17 poses |
| reachy_mini | Stewart platform desktop (Pollen Robotics) | None | STUB |
| bhl | Berkeley Humanoid Lite biped | None | STUB |

## Intent Tokens
17 tokens covering: attending, confused, nod, shake, sulk, bashful, amused, surprised, curious, alarmed, excited, tired, attentive_listen, celebrate, apologetic, present, idle.

## Safety
- DriveGeometryGuard: checks LIDAR clearance before retreat
- TimeoutPolicy: auto-terminates persistent intents (sulk: 15s, tired: 60s) with recovery sequence

## Stream Recording
All intent expressions are recorded to SQLite for playback. Enables regression testing without live hardware.

## Known Limitations
- Boomy: No head pitch (nod is gimbal-only). No arms. No face expression.
- VRM renderer: Pose-only, no animation playback yet (keyframes are static).
- Reachy Mini: STUB — no hardware available for testing.
- BHL: STUB — no hardware path without building the robot.

## Development
- uv sync to install
- just serve-stdio for stdio mode
- just serve-http for HTTP mode (port 11128)
- just lint / just fix for code quality
- just ci for the full gate (ruff, pyright, pytest, tsc, biome)
- NEKOMIMI_YAHBOOM_URL env var for Boomy connection

## REST endpoints (HTTP mode, consumed by webapp + fleet launcher)
- GET /health, GET /api/status, GET /api/skills (+ /api/skills/{name}),
  GET /api/capabilities, GET /api/v1/diagnostics, POST /api/shutdown
- GET /api/llm/discover|providers|models|onboarding, POST /api/llm/chat,
  POST /api/chat (skill-first + offline fallback), GET /api/fleet/apps
- MCP itself on POST /mcp (Accept: application/json, text/event-stream; SSE frames)
